item.title: Alabama Supreme Court denies Charles Bediako’s request for interim injunction
item.description: TUSCALOOSA, Ala. item.description: TRUSSVILLE, Ala. (WIAT) -- The national weather service has confirmed a tornado touched down in the city of Trussville Thursday afternoon.
